title: Exchange Updates &  B, C OTC Community Offer
body:
## Updates and Clarity
Per our last community call, I want to make some details clear:

1. Exchange A is obviously seriously delayed. We continue to request updates but they have not been communicative, which due to the nature of the arrangement leaves us with little choice but to ask repeatedly, a lot. 
2. The Agency as of last Friday is taking on the business development functions largely carried by CW Labs, this includes fulfilling the details of the Exchange B and C proposals.
3. I fully acknowledge that there has been insufficient speed and updates here. We will ensure that ends with this post, and will provide continued updates on the exchange status in this thread.
4. Timelines: B and C may well complete technical integrations before A at this pace. One of these we may want to delay slightly in order to maximize PR impact if technical readiness occurs at the same point.  They both estimated 2-4 weeks max to ready.



## Community OTC Offer

The [details of this offer to purchase EDG from the Treasury as approved in the B and C proposals are here.](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1miSKmPW402gtCcU6VNDxth5b-e070ggFwaJb3aCkxsk/edit?usp=sharing) Note that there are requirements to participate in the sake of speed, including KYC requirements if escrows are required. 

[The full details of the proposals along with multisig signatories and obligations can be viewed here.](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1drKKj8Vng_Fs0aLDoKJ6ElWID8Md7NOCU8BWdCGlvSQ/edit?usp=sharing)

**If you are interested in participating in this OTC, please contact [thom@edgeware.agency ](thom@edgware.agency )by email with your purchase requests.**

If there is feedback on this process, please use this thread.  The Agency's priorities at this time are restoring exchange functionality, and doing so in a community-oriented way. Accordingly, single critiques will be seriously considered but may not necessarily halt or alter the process- collective action has weight.

**June 1 2021 --- Exchan
